interpretation.grain: One normal-run row per condition/repetition; counter builds separate from shipping timing
interpretation.matrixSettings: 12 conditions x3, minimum6000ms, complete20-move cycles; exactly40 measured moves each
interpretation.soakSettings: Full intended600000ms; Lite180000ms; same23x23 maze, five followers, board input. Complete cycles extend minimum duration.
interpretation.rounding: Derived displayed millisecond values rounded to0.001ms; raw evidence authoritative
interpretation.hashNamespaces: ManifestDigest hashes sorted file-record JSON, not manifest file bytes. Build fingerprints use existing provenance algorithm; build checkout commits can predate uncommitted snapshot changes, so content fingerprints—not commit labels alone—identify delivered bytes. Canonical fixture JSON and pretty fixture file hashes intentionally differ.
interpretation.frameMeasurement: rAF intervals are not presentation-to-display/GPU frame measurements; input-rAF is a proxy; final metric transfer included in elapsedMs/CDP aggregate, not sampleEndFromRafMs.
limitations: Sequential, nonstationary development host; strong free-RAM variation; no thermal control.
Candidate Full recovery follows Codex crash/restart; cannot infer causal before/after percentage speedup.
Random BGM track not fixed across contexts; exact media workload not matched.
Counters/injected builds measure work, not shipping frame-time authority; v3/v4 JS byte-identical.
Same-maze loops do not qualify multi-maze asset transitions or retained heap; no forcedGC, collector retains arrays, JS heap excludes image/GPU/native memory.
Unattributed long tasks and occasional worse candidate tails remain open; no zero-stutter or physical-iPad/Tauri success claim.
